malignancy_category.definition: Primary malignancy type of the patient. mds = known myelodysplastic syndrome; myeloid_malignancy = known myeloid malignancy other than MDS; all = acute lymphoblastic leukemia.

treatment_intent.definition: Stated intent of the current or planned anticancer treatment.

chemotherapy_regimen_intensity.definition: Intensity category of the planned or current chemotherapy regimen.

prior_chemo_or_radiation.definition: Patient has received prior chemotherapy or radiation therapy.

recent_surgery_or_open_wound.definition: Patient has had recent surgery and/or an open wound.

other_patient_fn_risk_factor.definition: Patient has another listed patient risk factor for febrile neutropenia that is stated in the case and is not captured by the other variables.

fn_risk_table_percent.definition: Febrile neutropenia risk (%) read from the guideline risk table for this disease, chemotherapy regimen, patient risk factors and treatment intent. Not stated directly in case text.

dose_limiting_neutropenic_event.definition: Patient has had a dose-limiting neutropenic event.

subsequent_chemotherapy_cycle.definition: The evaluation concerns the second or a subsequent chemotherapy cycle.

prior_gcsf_use.definition: Patient has previously received G-CSF therapy.

prophylactic_gcsf_type.definition: Prophylactic G-CSF the patient receives or has received.

infection_complication_risk_factors_pres.definition: Patient has risk factors for an infection-associated complication.

hars_radiation_myelosuppression.definition: Patient has radiation-induced myelosuppression after a radiologic or nuclear incident (hematopoietic acute radiation syndrome).

suspected_cit.definition: Thrombocytopenia is suspected to be chemotherapy-induced.

other_thrombocytopenia_cause_identified.definition: On evaluation for thrombocytopenia, another cause was identified (for example graft failure, GVHD, drugs, infection).

platelet_recovery_failure_post_hct.definition: Primary or secondary failure of platelet recovery after hematopoietic cell transplant.

prior_hematopoietic_cell_transplant.definition: Patient has had a prior hematopoietic cell transplant.

receiving_iec_therapy.definition: Patient is receiving or scheduled for immune effector cell (IEC) therapy.

suspected_icaht.definition: Immune effector cell-associated hematotoxicity (ICAHT) is suspected.

largest_tumor_diameter_cm.definition: Largest diameter of a tumor lesion as stated in the case.

preexisting_inflammatory_state.definition: Patient has a pre-existing inflammatory state.

receipt_of_bridging_therapy.definition: Patient has received bridging therapy before IEC therapy.

iec_associated_toxicity_identified.definition: An IEC-associated toxicity (for example macrophage activation syndrome) is identified on evaluation.

hemoglobin_decline_from_baseline_g_dl.definition: Decline of current hemoglobin from the patient's baseline hemoglobin, as stated in the case.

anemia_cause_identified.definition: On evaluation for anemia, a cause was identified.

severe_fatigue_preventing_usual_activity.definition: Patient has severe fatigue that prevents work and usual activity.

progressive_hb_decline_after_intensive_t.definition: Progressive decline in hemoglobin after recent intensive chemotherapy or radiation.

ckd_moderate_to_severe.definition: Patient has moderate to severe chronic kidney disease.

anticancer_therapy_type.definition: Current anticancer therapy the patient is receiving.

on_esa_therapy.definition: Patient is receiving erythropoiesis-stimulating agent (ESA) therapy.

hemoglobin_change_after_4_weeks_iron_g_d.definition: Change in hemoglobin from the start of iron supplementation to 4 weeks later (positive = increase).

thrombocytopenia_duration_weeks.definition: Weeks the platelet count has stayed below 100,000/mcL following the last chemotherapy administration and/or following delays in chemotherapy initiation related to thrombocytopenia, as stated in the case.

fn_risk_category.definition: Febrile neutropenia risk category for a planned chemotherapy regimen, from the guideline risk table: High (>20%), Intermediate (10%-20%), Low (<10%).

has_fn_patient_risk_factor.definition: Patient has at least one listed patient risk factor for febrile neutropenia.

high_tumor_burden.definition: Patient has high tumor burden. The boxes do not print the criteria; the thresholds below are placeholders from a standard published definition and must be verified against the source before use.
high_tumor_burden.criteria_source: external: unverified placeholder thresholds (LDH > 250 u/l; largest tumor diameter >= 10 cm), not printed in the boxes or footnotes; verify before use

icaht_risk_group.definition: ICAHT risk group before IEC therapy, based on the count of listed ICAHT risk factors.

anemia_criteria_met.definition: Anemia criteria for evaluation: hemoglobin 11 g/dL or lower, or 2 g/dL or more below baseline.

anemia_cancer_category.definition: Clinical category of anemia in a patient with cancer.

esa_use_category.definition: Special ESA-use category for anemia in patients with cancer.

iron_status.definition: Iron status from the iron panel (ferritin and TSAT), with ESA context.

thrombocytopenia_post_hct.definition: Thrombocytopenia after hematopoietic cell transplant: prior HCT and platelets below 100,000/mcL for 3 to 4 weeks or more following last chemotherapy and/or following delays in chemotherapy initiation related to thrombocytopenia. Encoded with the lower bound of 3 weeks.

notes.predicates: Conditions were drafted and reviewed by a language model (model_reviewed), not by clinicians. 'rejected' means the review rejected the draft; the box then needs clinician judgement. 'section_only' means the box only requires the patient to be in the page's guideline section.
notes.coordinates: bbox and line_bboxes are PDF points with the origin at the page's top left; pages[].size gives the page size.
notes.links: page links name a page id from pages[]; a multi-page code such as PROS-F has ids 'PROS-F 1 of 5' ... ; external_guideline links name another guideline's slug.
